guide.title: Which anode do I need?
guide.lead: Answer three questions: which water, which part, what size.
guide.s1d: Anode material is chosen by the water. The wrong material either wastes away at once or does nothing at all.
guide.s1zn: Sea water → zinc (Zn). The usual choice on the Turkish coast.
guide.s1al: Brackish water, river mouths, mixed use → aluminium (Al). Lighter and longer lasting.
guide.s1mg: Fresh water, lakes, rivers → magnesium (Mg). Never in sea water; it wastes away far too fast.
guide.s2d: Every submerged metal part needs its own anode. One anode does not protect the rest.
guide.s3zn: For a shaft anode, measure the shaft diameter (outside diameter, mm).
guide.s3al: For a propeller anode, measure the nut or hub diameter.
guide.s3mg: If you are unsure, remove the old anode and send us a photo and a caliper reading on WhatsApp.
guide.whenD: The common rule: replace the anode once it is half gone. Do not wait for it to disappear — the moment the anode is spent, the metal it protects starts to corrode. Service life varies a great deal with how much the boat is used, the marina it lies in and any stray current, so check at every haul-out.
guide.warnD: An anode has to touch the water. Paint, antifouling or grease on it and it stops working entirely. The mounting face must be clean bare metal too — rust or a layer of paint breaks the electrical contact.
guide.askD: Send a photo of the old anode along with your boat make and engine model, and we will tell you which one fits.

about.title: Casting is what we do
about.p1: KUT MARİN DÖKÜM produces anodes and cast lead in Karabağlar, İzmir, supplying boat owners, marinas, shipyards and diving businesses.
about.p2: We do not buy in and relabel: we cast our own. Standard sizes are in the catalogue; for anything that is not, send a sample or the dimensions and we make the mould and cast it.
about.p3: We do not present a product we do not have as if we did. If it is not in stock we tell you when we can cast it, and if it is not suitable we say so plainly.
about.v1d: We will not sell you an anode that is wrong for your water; we ask where it will be used first.
about.v2t: If the size does not fit
about.v2d: When a catalogue size does not seat properly, we cast a custom one.
about.v3d: Known prices are published here; where we do not know one, we do not invent a figure.
